name: Hack
description: When corruption charges strip him of his job, his family and his pride, former cop Mike Olshansky forges a new identity as a Philadelphia cab driver, patrolling the city as a roving vigilante who works with local police.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Mike helps a minister find his runaway teenage daughter who was lured to Philadelphia by an online child predator.

videos.title: Favors
videos.overview: Mike comes to regret helping a gambler who owes money to a bookie; Marcellus requests his old partner's assistance in apprehending a suspected killer.

videos.title: Domestic Disturbance
videos.overview: Olshansky picks up Jeanine Adams and her daughter and takes them to a shelter. Jeanine tells Olshansky her cop husband has abused her. Olshansky calls on Marcellus Washington for help but Washington believes Jeanine's husband is innocent.

videos.title: My Alibi
videos.overview: Olshansky picks up a hysterical man who claims his former business partner, Boone is out of prison and he fears he will harm him. When Olshansky intervenes, Boone files assault charges against him.

videos.title: My Brother's Keeper
videos.overview: Vanessa Griffin's wants her brother Teddy to get off drugs and asks for Olshansky's help. Olshansky agrees to help but gets involved with a violent drug gang when Teddy steals their drug stash.

videos.title: Slippery Slope
videos.overview: A shady nightclub owner offers Olshansky a job as his driver. Olshansky reluctantly agrees. The financially strapped hack eventually gets involved in collections for his loan-shark boss. He struggles with ethical issues.

videos.title: Husbands and Wives
videos.overview: Subsequent to an investigation into the case of a bookie whose wife and lawyer claim they are being framed, all are not as they seem. Olshansky is aghast to discover that Washington planted evidence in a faulty report.

videos.title: Songs in the Night
videos.overview: When a homeless man dies in his cab, Olshansky sets out to find the man's estranged family.

videos.title: Bad Choices
videos.overview: After reluctantly picking up Chuck, a frantic naked fare, Olshansky agrees to help him track down the hooker who stole his wallet, clothes and, most importantly, his wedding rig. but the hooker's pimp has already gotten the ring from her.

videos.title: All Night Long
videos.overview: Olshansky goes through a series of tribulations while attempting to return $10,000 in cash he found in the backseat of his cab. He runs into a woman who is being blackmailed for the same amount and he offers to help.

videos.title: Obsession
videos.overview: Olshansky meets Abby Banks, who claims she's being chased by a stalker who's been after her for two years and three cities. Abby hires Olshansky to guard her, but a Chicago cop who also protected Abby reveals there may not be a stalker at all.

videos.title: A Dangerous Game
videos.overview: Mike helps a Department of Justice employee whose sister has been kidnapped by a hitman who wants information about a banker in the Witness Protection Program who is scheduled to testify against the drug dealer whose money he laundered.

videos.title: Death of Innocence
videos.overview: Mike investigates a friend's death, believing it's not the hit and run that it seems, and runs afoul of Marcellus' new partner, Aldo Rossi.

videos.title: Forgive, But Don't Forget
videos.overview: Mike Jr. finds the divorce papers of his parents. Badakian the IAB cop who is responsible for Olshansky being suspended and under indictment and now is looking at Washington stops at a store and his son is shot while waiting outside. Badakian asks for Olshansky's help when the shooter gets released after the sole witness against him is killed.

videos.title: Brothers in Arms
videos.overview: Olshansky is taken hostage by the brother of a man on death row. He is threatening to execute Mike if his brother is executed.

videos.title: Black Eye
videos.overview: Romantic feelings resurface between Olshansky and his high school girlfriend as he reconnects with her while trying to help her schizophrenic sister.

videos.title: Third Strike
videos.overview: A 2-time convictee witnesses a muder while committing a burglary. He can't come forward when the wrong person is arrested without implicating himself in a crime, so he enlists Mike's help.

videos.title: Sinners and Saints
videos.overview: Olshansky takes a man to the hospital, was mistreated. Heather witnesses the doctor changing the records to cover up his mistake.

videos.title: Signature
videos.overview: Olshansky sets out to prove that a man he helped convict years ago is actually innocent.

videos.title: All Others Pay Cash
videos.overview: Mike gets closer to his dying father. Grizz contemplates leaving the priesthood because of his affection for Beth. Mickey acts distant towards his Mom's (Heather) new boyfriend.

videos.title: True Lies
videos.overview: Marcellus is accused by junkie woman of stealing money. Olshansky checks if it is true.

videos.title: The Squeeze
videos.overview: Mike helps Marcellus find the killer of his past informant, while Marcellus helps resolve Mike's felony charges. Mike helps Mikey make the adjustment to his new life with Heather's future husband.

videos.title: See No Evil
videos.overview: While setting up his new life, Mike helps a young blind man who is being chased by dirty cops.

videos.title: Hidden Agenda
videos.overview: Olshansky checks into the case of a man accused of being a terrorist by the FBI.

videos.title: Presumed Guilty
videos.overview: A man who claims to have been faksely accused, but got off on a technicality, still wants to be exonerated with the public so he can get his life back.

videos.title: Collateral Damage
videos.overview: While Mike identifies the man who shot Marcellus as someone who escaped from a drug dealer take-down long ago, a second attempt on Marcellus's life points to the possibility of two different shooters; forced to hide out from some bad guys, Jamie temporarily moves in with Mike, and Liz teaches him how to be a good neighbor.

videos.title: Out of the Ashes
videos.overview: A woman that Olshansky rescued from attackers later decides to kill her assailants.

videos.title: My Fare Lady
videos.overview: Someone is trying to kill an amnesia victim. Mike protects her while trying to help her find her identity.

videos.title: The Looking Glass
videos.overview: Jamie's father's mistress is murdered. Olshansky investigates.

videos.title: Blind Faith
videos.overview: Mike gets ripped off by an apparently mentally unstable woman, but ends up trying to help her.

videos.title: To Have and Have Not
videos.overview: Washington is upset that the life of a 12 year-old placed in a shelter hasn't improved, while Jamie catches a grisly discovery regarding a friend's sister.

videos.title: Dial O For Murder
videos.overview: Olshansky's telephone number written on her hand is the only clue in the naked murder victim's case.

videos.title: Gone
videos.overview: Olshansky's son, Mikey, is kidnapped by an assassin in order to make Mike find and turn over a Russian mobster that he drives around.

videos.title: Calibrated Arguments
videos.overview: Olshansky is being sued by the mother of the thief who was killed as Mike tried to get his money back.

videos.title: Double Exposure
videos.overview: Jamie and a friend with a secret get beaten up. His friend asks Jamie not to report it to the police, so Olshansky does.

videos.title: Fog of War
videos.overview: Mike steps in to help his cousin who's caught a downward spiral of  addiction and suicidal urges as he combats post-traumatic stress after serving in Iraq.

videos.title: Extreme Commerce
videos.overview: Mike uncovers an illicit adoption ring trafficking in stolen babies when he grudgingly agrees to help one of Liz's clients, a former addict who's turned her life around, in the search for her missing child; Marcellus calls an end to it when he realizes that his obsession over the new man in Deborah's life has gone too far.

videos.title: Misty Blue
videos.overview: Mike attempts to return a cellphone to a stripper who left the device in his cab. He discovers that the woman has disappeared and fears she's been abducted.

videos.title: One For My Baby
videos.overview: Olshansky engages in a reverie, reflecting on the time he crossed paths with a gorgeous, rich woman he encountered after saving her husband from a paid assassin.

videos.title: The Reckoning
videos.overview: Olshansky's life as a cop plagues him when a drug-dealer he sent away threatens Olanshky and anyone close to him.
